name: Amoxliatl

mechanics.name: Standard Attack
mechanics.description: Her ordinary attack, thrown steadily throughout the fight.
mechanics.counterplay: Keep the matching overhead up. Her damage is modest as long as you are praying correctly.

mechanics.name: Unstable Ice
mechanics.description: She summons blocks of unstable ice around the arena. They freeze anyone caught by them.
mechanics.counterplay: Break the ice or keep away from it. Being frozen while the rest of her attacks land is what kills.

mechanics.name: Cracking Floor
mechanics.description: Cracks open across the floor and shed the ice she has built up.
mechanics.counterplay: Watch where the cracks appear and keep off them.

_note: SKELETON, NOT LIVE-VERIFIED, AND THIN. Provenance: gamevals from runelite-api 1.12.35 (net.runelite.api.gameval.*), because this cache download ships an empty GAMEVALS index (idx24) and ScanGameVal cannot read it; npc names, models, sequences and extents from the live cache (revision of 2026-08-06). Npc ids 13685, 13686, 13687 and 13689 all carry the same two-part model set and standing animation 11528; which is the live one is not established, so all four are in npcIds. Animations are the AMOXLIATL_* set, all unambiguous gameval names: ATTACK 11530, SUMMON 11533, ICE_DESTROY 11534 and UNSTABLE_ICE_SPAWN 11536. AMOXLIATL_POINT 11531 is an emote and is not curated. Projectile VFX_AMOXLIATL_ICE_BLOCK_PROJECTILE_01 11538 is curated because it says projectile outright; VFX_AMOXLIATL_ICE_BLOCK_PROJECTILE_IMPACT_01 11537, the two CRACK ids 11539 and 11540, and the three ICE_FLOOR ids 11541 through 11543 are graphics and are left out, since a graphic trigger has no source actor to check (docs/DECISIONS.md D17) and discovery never revokes (D18). Note 11538 sits in the animation space in the gamevals dump; whether a spotanim of the same id exists for a projectile trigger to read has not been established, which is followup 3. THE SET NAMES ONLY ONE ATTACK SEQUENCE, so her attack styles cannot be split, and three mechanics is the limit of what the cache supports rather than a judgement about the fight. This is one of the least well described bosses in the wave despite being recent. staticFallback is false on all three; whether each body animation reads has not been eyeballed in game. THIS BOSS'S ANIMATIONS ARE SKELETAL, SO THE PREVIEW VALUES ARE AN ESTIMATE, NOT ARITHMETIC (docs/DECISIONS.md D36). FitZoom returned empty extents. The values follow the method Doom of Mokhaiotl already ships under: take the zoom from struct 1020, the Combat Achievements screen's own entry, which pins model 54438 at zoom 2250, and compute shiftY from the bind pose extents at that zoom; the zoom was then raised from 2250 to 2526 because the bind-pose shiftY at 2250 projected past the 70px half-box ceiling BundledBossDataTest enforces. The collection log page is titled 'Amoxliatl', matching 'name'.
